[FACT] User is using AutoCAD LT 2013.

[CHANGE] User is unsure about the meaning of "step 3" in the provided instructions.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The steps provided were for a newer version of AutoCAD, and the user interface has changed over the years.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] For AutoCAD LT 2013, the user can customize the mouse buttons and assign the zoom window function to the right-click button.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Steps to customize mouse buttons:  
1. Open the Customize User Interface (CUI) dialog box: Type "CUI" in the command line and hit Enter.  
2. Expand the Mouse Buttons section.  
3. Locate the "ZOOM" category.  
4. Assign the "Zoom Window" function to the right-click button.  
5. Save the changes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] If the right-click button does not work as expected, try resetting AutoCAD LT to its default settings or checking for updates.  
[FACT] User states there is no right mouse button option in the mouse buttons section, only "click shift plus click," "control plus click," and "control plus shift click."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested steps to customize the right-click button in AutoCAD LT 2013:  
1. Go to the Options dialog box.  
2. Go to the User Preferences tab.  
3. Customize the right-click button.  
4. Assign the zoom window function.  
5. Save the changes.  
[FACT] User mentions they cannot see a mouse section, only a button called "right click customization."  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested steps to assign the zoom window function to the right-click button:  
1. Go to the Options dialog box.  
2. Go to the User Preferences tab.  
3. Customize the right-click button.  
4. Create a new command.  
5. Name the command and assign the command "\_ZOOMW."  
6. Assign the command to the right-click button.  
7. Save the changes.  
[FACT] User states there is no "new command" button in this version.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested steps to assign the zoom window function to the right-click button:  
1. Go to the Options dialog box.  
2. Go to the User Preferences tab.  
3. Customize the right-click button.  
4. Assign the zoom window function.  
5. Save the changes.
